headline: Definity Financial Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Definity Financial (TSE:DFY) said its second-quarter results reflected continued growth, early synergy capture and progress integrating the Travelers business it acquired, as the insurer raised its annual expense-synergy target by 25%. Gross written premiums increased 34.7% from a year earlier to C
